# Codevalanche

> Codevalanche is a local-first workspace for coding agents, real repositories, visible changes and evidence-driven review. It is made by Radovar.

The English site is available at `/`. Localized versions are generated for the languages listed in the footer. Account and authentication routes are private service flows and are not part of the public discovery content.
